memory_candidates.content: ExistPart only handles constant-parent envs (Fin.cons x (fun _ => t)). Non-constant envs [y,x,t] with x != t require GeneralExistPart -- a third mutual induction conjunct alongside CharPart and ExistPart. The recursion is on depth k with arity r increasing: GeneralExistPart(k+1,r) requires GeneralExistPart(k,r+1). Terminates because k strictly decreases. Base case k=0 is purely atomic and encodable via zone decomposition + nested Until/Since (Rabinovich Prop 3.5).

Transfer theorem for non-constant envs (nonconstenv_exist_transfer) is FALSE: on Z, envs [0,2] and [0,1] have same 1-var NFs and order patterns but different 2-var NFs because interval (0,2) contains 1 while (0,1) is empty. This holds even on Prior structures. The formula enrichment approach (GeneralExistPart) is the only correct solution.
